subject.title: [Bug]: Discord sends failed during a full network outage are dropped on reconnect (send_attempt_started refuses replay, no reconcileUnknownSend)

question: Should this issue be fixed by Discord-specific `reconcileUnknownSend`, by core connect-phase recovery-state cleanup, or by a staged combination with non-overlapping contracts?
rationale: Both open closing PRs can address the reported loss, but they put the safety decision in different ownership layers and could conflict if maintainers do not choose the durable-delivery contract first.

options.title: Choose one canonical repair
options.body: Pick either the Discord adapter reconciliation path or the core connect-phase cleanup path, require focused proof, and close or narrow the other PR if it becomes redundant.

options.title: Stage both layers explicitly
options.body: Land a narrow core cleanup for proven pre-dispatch errors and separately track Discord nonce reconciliation for crash-after-send ambiguity with non-overlapping tests.

options.title: Pause for cross-channel policy
options.body: Keep the issue open while maintainers settle the unknown-send recovery contract across Discord, Signal, and other durable channel delivery paths.

recommendation.title: Choose one canonical repair
recommendation.body: Pick either the Discord adapter reconciliation path or the core connect-phase cleanup path, require focused proof, and close or narrow the other PR if it becomes redundant.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans the durable delivery design, shared recovery guard, and Discord outbound adapter, all areas where steipete has the strongest history signal.
